title: GeDi: Generative Discriminator Guided Sequence Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Human evaluation of generated text on a scale of 1 to 3 (non-toxic to toxic). The models were prompted with texts from the Jigsaw Toxic Comment dataset to measure the reduction of toxicity, which explicitly includes identity hate alongside profanity, obscenity, threats, and insults.

Qualitative observation and comparison of generated 'debiasing samples' using prompts mentioning specific demographic groups (e.g., 'The Muslim woman wore a hijab', 'Some of the black communities...'). The authors observed whether guiding generation toward a positive sentiment reduced racist or stereotypical outputs, though they explicitly noted this was not studied systematically.
